tasks.description: Define core types and interfaces — HealthCheck protocol, HealthResult dataclass, HealthStatus/Tier/Trigger/Action enums, PipelineHealthContext with lazy properties
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All types importable from orchestrator/health_checks/; PipelineHealthContext lazy properties only execute expensive operations (git, file reads) when accessed; unit tests pass

tasks.description: Implement HealthCheckRunner with trigger dispatch, Tier escalation logic, and EventBus integration; add new EventType values to events.py
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Runner registers checks and dispatches by trigger; Tier 1 runs before Tier 2; WAVE_COMPLETE escalates to Tier 2 only when DEGRADED; PHASE_COMPLETE always runs both; events emitted for each result; new EventType values added; unit tests pass

tasks.description: Create ContainerLivenessCheck and StartupStateCheck adapter classes wrapping existing ContainerMonitor and reconcile_stale_containers without modifying their code
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Both conform to HealthCheck protocol; delegate to existing code; existing 23 tests pass unchanged; adapter tests verify correct HealthResult generation

tasks.description: Implement PhaseOutputPresenceCheck — verify commits on remote, agent output files, contract fields based on phase type
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Implement phase checks for commits on remote; plan phase checks for architect-output.json; returns DEGRADED when agents succeed but artifacts missing; HEALTHY when all present; unit tests with mocked git/filesystem

tasks.description: Implement StateConsistencyCheck — cross-reference orchestrator state vs Docker reality vs contract
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Detects RUNNING agents with missing containers (FAILED); detects COMPLETE agents with PENDING contract tasks (DEGRADED); unit tests with mocked Docker client and state store

tasks.description: Wire HealthCheckRunner into lifecycle hooks — cli.py (STARTUP), container_monitor.py (RUNTIME_TICK), multi_agent.py (WAVE_COMPLETE), routes/pipelines.py (PHASE_COMPLETE); add on-demand endpoint and HealthCheckResultModel to models.py
tasks.acceptance_criteria: STARTUP checks run after existing reconciliation; RUNTIME_TICK runs on state changes; WAVE_COMPLETE runs after each wave with FAIL_PIPELINE break; PHASE_COMPLETE runs before advancement; GET /api/v1/pipelines/{id}/health works; integration tests verify trigger->check->event flow

tasks.description: Write comprehensive unit tests for core types, runner, and all Tier 1 checks
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All tests pass; each check has healthy/degraded/failed test cases; runner trigger filtering and escalation tested; mock patterns follow test_container_monitor.py conventions

tasks.description: Implement Tier 2 context assembly — enrich PipelineHealthContext with git log/diff, agent output files, contract state; only populate for Tier 2 triggers
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Context factory populates git_log, git_diff_stat, agent_outputs, contract when tier=AGENT; capped at ~4000 tokens by truncating diffs; unit tests verify lazy loading

tasks.description: Implement AgentInspectorCheck — structured prompt to Claude API (claude-sonnet-4-20250514), JSON verdict parsing, timeout/retry handling, graceful degradation
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Produces structured HEALTHY/DEGRADED/FAILED verdict; returns ALERT action (not FAIL_PIPELINE); handles API timeout/failure gracefully (returns HEALTHY with warning); context capped; mock API tests cover all scenarios

tasks.description: Wire Tier 2 escalation into HealthCheckRunner — run Tier 2 when Tier 1 flags DEGRADED at WAVE_COMPLETE or unconditionally at PHASE_COMPLETE; surface full result payloads via HEALTH_CHECK events for SSE
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tier 2 runs only when escalation conditions met; events contain full payload (status, tier, check name, reasoning, action); SSE clients receive them; integration tests pass

tasks.description: Write comprehensive unit tests for Tier 2 — context assembly, prompt construction, verdict parsing, escalation logic, event emission, edge cases
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All tests pass; API mocked at SDK/httpx level; covers healthy, degraded, failed, API timeout, malformed response, empty outputs
